messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: High auth failure spike detected on svc-proxy-eu1. 401 rate up 18x over baseline in last 5m. Top source ranges: 34.88.0.0/16, 52.23.0.0/16. Possible token re-use or leaked session cookies. Alert ID: PB-1881818181

Ria (oncall): saw this, paging eng-sre. tagging @Mike.

Mike (eng-sre): looking. can we get a quick sample of requests? which endpoint is spiking?

pagerbot: sample: /v1/auth/validate and /embeddings/stream are top endpoints. Error pattern: Authorization header present but token rejected, consistent 401.

Olivia (security): sounds like credential shadowing or replay. ask SRE to gate external traffic and snapshot audited incoming headers. set sampling to 100% for proxy logs.

Ria (oncall): on it. increasing proxy debug logging and enabling capture for the top CIDR ranges. ETA ~2m.

Mike (eng-sre): capture enabled. running quick aggregation: majority of requests contain `x-client-id: svc-legacy-2020` header. odd — that service token was deprecated and rotated in 2023.

Jen (support): any customer impact? Support queues showing a few customer 401s but not widespread. I can push a note to platinum customers if confirmed.

Olivia (security): prioritize containment. recommended immediate steps: 1) block offending CIDRs at edge WAF, 2) revoke/rotate svc-legacy-2020 token, 3) disable log forwarding for staging sinks while we assess for leak.

Kai (infra): can apply WAF block now. prepping ACL change. will push a short deny rule for 34.88.0.0/16 and 52.23.0.0/16.

Bobby (prodops): before rotating token, we need to identify dependent services. run `rbxctl find-token-usage svc-legacy-2020 --all` and dump list.

Mike (eng-sre): running that now. output shows 3 internal services and 1 deprecated webhook connector in partner infra. tagging Carlos for legal on partner reachout.

Carlos (legal): noted. if partner connector is implicated we need to open an expedited data-sharing and notification review. prepping template.

Ria (oncall): WAF deny pushed to edge, confirmed 34.88.0.0/16 + 52.23.0.0/16 blocked (prod-edge). latency dropback observed.

Mike (eng-sre): `rbxctl rotate-service-key svc-legacy-2020 --force --dry-run=false` queued. will perform rotation after we snapshot dependent services and schedule a quick restart. planning a 5m rolling rotate to avoid mass disruption.

Olivia (security): before rotate: snapshot logs and S3 buckets that might contain the token. set an emergency retention hold and export keys for forensics. runbook: https://internal.runbooks.redwood/auth-incident (see section 2.2).

Mike (eng-sre): snapshot complete, key rotate in progress. will post status when each pool finishes.

Jen (support): started a short message to affected customers (internal channel + support). no P1 open yet but prepping FAQs.

pagerbot: action: rotate-service-key svc-legacy-2020 -> SUCCESS (1881818310). All long-lived tokens invalidated.

Ria (oncall): rotate done. confirming internal services restarted.

Mike (eng-sre): 3 internal services restarted and passed health checks. webhook connector from partner failed — 403 now. Carlos, please proceed with partner outreach.

Carlos (legal): initiating partner contact. request logs for connector usage and deletion plan.

Olivia (security): forensic notes: found copies of header dumps in a staging S3 bucket (s3://redwood-staging-dump/old-headers-2021). seems like historical dev artifact containing `svc-legacy-2020` tokens. adding to incident binder.

Bobby (prodops): scheduling immediate cleanup job to remove sensitive artifacts and trigger org-wide scan for `svc-legacy-2020` string.

Ria (oncall): summary for handoff: edge blocks in place, service token rotated, 3 internal services restarted, partner connector blocked (legal engaged), staging S3 artifact identified and scheduled for deletion + audit. recommended next: full scan for other leaked tokens, postmortem, customer comms draft.

Jen (support): I'll hold on public comms until legal ok, but will notify affected customers directly (partner connector owner).

Olivia (security): tagging follow-ups: - run broad S3 search for token pattern by EOD - add regression alert to catch deprecated token usage - review deprecation policy to ensure revoked tokens are never left in artifacts

Mike (eng-sre): creating an incident ticket INC-18818 with timeline + artifacts and assigning owners.

Ria (oncall): handing off to day shift SRE at 1881818450. please pick up the runbook and continue remediation checks. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
